name: Seikimatsu no Shi
source:
[b]10 years have passed since then[/b]
The collapse of the bubble economy marked the end of an era.

At the turn of the millennium: [url=https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/1997_Asian_financial_crisis]financial crisis[/url], [url=https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Year_2000_problem]Y2K bug[/url], [url=https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Tokyo_subway_sarin_attack]Tokyo subway sarin attack[/url], [url=https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Employment_Ice_Age]employment ice age[/url], [url=https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/1998_China_floods]the 1998 great flood[/url], and prophecies of the end of the world... A staggering era was quietly approaching us.


[b]5 years have passed since then[/b]
The official sequel to "[url=/v24208]Christmas Tina[/url]" by the original team once again pushes the limits of visual novel storytelling.

Here and now. A "Chinese" and a "Japanese" meet once more in a non-romantic encounter. At the end of the century, a journey begins—from the first (her) to the last (her)...

[From [url=https://store.steampowered.com/news/app/1049100/view/537735054151909590?l=english]Steam[/url]]
